constants.CLASH_TOLERANCE_MM: gate_clash.py - None until given; while None every penetration is hard
constants.BOLT_WELD_CLEARANCE_MM: gate_clash.py - None until given; W1 then reports NOT EVALUATED
constants.BOLT_EDGE_MIN_D: gate_clash.py - 1.25 (x bolt diameter), AISC 360-16 J3.4 as used in bimsteelauto_connections/secondary.py

sets.name: fasteners vs parts
exclude_source: else: the parts of the IfcElementAssembly the fastener is aggregated in

sets.name: bolt to edge
sets.rule: distance from each bolt-hole centre to the outer contour of the part it voids >= BOLT_EDGE_MIN_D x the bolt's NominalDiameter; needs extract.py (step 3) - until then NOT EVALUATED

pass_rule: gate passes only when every hard set has 0 penetrations deeper than CLASH_TOLERANCE_MM; warning sets never block; CLASH_TOLERANCE_MM = None fails the gate
